articleTitle: Applications of Artificial Neural Networks in Financial Economics: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper is a survey on the application of artificial neural networks in forecasting financial market prices. The objective of this paper is to appraise the potential of using artificial neural networks to predict the financial system, as it is reflected in many relevant articles. It will provide some guidelines and references for the research and implementation. This paper begins with an introduction to the theory of artificial neural networks. Subsequently it focuses on the forecast of stock prices and option pricing based on a non-linear ANN model. It proceeded with a presentation of the application of ANN in predicting exchange rates. The paper then reviewed the theoretical literature on the prediction of banking and financial crisis based on artificial neural networks. In general artificial neural network is a valuable forecast tool in financial economics due to the learning, generalization and nonlinear behavior properties. Finally it identifies a number of important opportunities for future research on the application of neural networks in financial economics.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Adaptive Unscented Kalman Filter for Ultra-Tight GPS/INS Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper presents a sensor fusion method based on the combination of adaptive unscented Kalman filter (UKF) and Fuzzy Logic Adaptive System (FLAS) for the ultra-tightly coupled GPS/INS integrated navigation. The UKF employs a set of sigma points by deterministic sampling, such that the linearization process is not necessary, and therefore the error caused by linearization as in the traditional extended Kalman filter (EKF) can be avoided. The adaptive algorithm has been one of the approaches to prevent divergence problem of the filter when precise knowledge on the system models are not available. Through the use of fuzzy logic, the FLAS has been incorporated into the AUKF as a mechanism for timely detecting the dynamical changes and implementing the on-line tuning of the factors in the weighted covariance matrices by monitoring the innovation information so as to maintain good estimation accuracy and tracking capability. The performance assessment for UKF and FUKF are carried out.

articleTitle: Based on k-Means and Fuzzy k-Means Algorithm Classification of Precipitation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In this paper, the author used K-means and fuzzy K-means to analyze the classification of precipitation in JingDeZhen City, and the results showed that using fuzzy k-means algorithm is a more efficient data clustering algorithm, with better value of promotion and practical application.

articleTitle: Haptic Texture Rendering Using Single Texture Image
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper describes a method of generation of forces from a two-dimensional static image to make texture tangible using haptic devices. The proposed technique consists in creating a height map computed thanks to Tsai & Shah algorithm – an algorithm in shape-from-shading. This height map is then used to generate the virtual surface, and forces fields creating haptic texture are calculated by a new haptic texture rendering model.

articleTitle: Research on Open SaaS Software Architecture Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Software as a Service (SaaS) provides the same instance of an application to multiple customers typically in a single-instance multi-tenant architecture mode, achieving a low cost, economies of scale. However, SaaS applications also face the three most important challenges : multi-tenant, configurable and extensible. While the current SaaS applications delivers standardized functions, this architecture does not match the dynamic business environment which demands flexibility and innovative approach to interactive requirements. This paper presents an open architecture to build SaaS solutions, the combination of SOA and EDI reference models to create a clear reference architecture, automatic path between the business specification layer and the technical implementation layer, tenants can take part in the design of business processes and we describe how individual services join the SaaS applications.

articleTitle: A Reliable and Efficient Hybrid PSO for Parameters Optimization of LS-SVM in Production Rate Prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Least square support vector machine (LS-SVM) has become an effective tool in nonlinear function estimation. But it is a hard optimization problem to determine kernel parameters for LS-SVM owing to its implicit form and numerous local optima. A reliable and efficient hybrid PSO algorithm named self-adaptive lattice PSO with chaotic operator (short for cPSO) is proposed, which can obtain the same results in different runs. Therefore, once the appropriate algorithm parameters are determined for some practical problem, it will always achieve satisfactory result in every run. In cPSO algorithm, a new chaotic operator is designed to replace random operators for population initialization and coefficients setting, which is a more efficient pseudo-random search strategy. To address the balance problem of standard PSO between exploration and exploitation, a bi-population strategy is adopted, in which one population search by Clerc's Constriction PSO with excellent convergence ability, and the other population performs self-adaptive lattice search with outstanding global exploration ability. The proposed method is used to establish the LS-SVM based predictive model between concentrate yield and the technical indices of all production procedures in the mineral dressing process. The practical results show that the proposed cPSO performs better than other optimization methods regarding both convergence accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Availability Analysis of Web-Server Clusters with QoS-Aware Load Balancing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Based on the stochastic high level Petri net, this paper put forward a new availability model of Web-server Clusters. This model facilitates availability analysis of per service type and whole services. Through the Numerical analysis, we find that different load distribution and scheduling algorithm has different availability under same loads.

articleTitle: Breaking Internet Banking CAPTCHA Based on Instance Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Visual textual CAPTCHAs have been widely used on Internet banking in China to defend against malicious bot programs. In this paper, four categories of representative CAPTCHAs are chosen to break. We present an efficient method for solving visual textual CAPTCHAs using image processing techniques and instance learning, such as graying, thresholding, interference noises removing, segmentation, character normalization, extracting feature vector for each character, and recognizing it based on instance learning. At last, we discuss defense from attacking viewpoint to improve the design of visual textual CAPTCHAs.

articleTitle: Variable Neighborhood Search for Uniform Parallel Machine Makespan Scheduling Problem with Release Dates
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In this study, the uniform parallel machine makespan problem with release dates is considered. The problem consists of a set of independent jobs with distinct processing times and release dates to be scheduled on a set of uniform parallel machines to minimize the makespan. This problem is proved to be an NP-hard problem, rendering it a challenging area for meta-heuristic approaches. Four methods are used to generate initial solutions for small and large problems and obtained the results by variable neighborhood search. Computational tests are performed on problems with up to 30 machines and 400 jobs, and indicate that the quality of VNS depend on the quality of initial solutions, therefore a robust VNS algorithm is presented. The proposed VNS approach yields high quality results for 2000 random instances.

articleTitle: Research of the Database Encryption Technique Based on Hybrid Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: To overcome the technique problem of key management and database encryption in the implementation process of database encryption system, some difficult technology of encrypt/decrypt engine in the implementation process are discussed, the hybrid cryptography encryption program is presented based on IDEA combined with RSA, and the encryption system is designed and realized. Satisfied effect is obtained while the program is used in the university management system for science research and development.

articleTitle: A Data Stream Outlier Delection Algorithm Based on Reverse K Nearest Neighbors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: A new data stream outlier detection algorithm SODRNN is proposed based on reverse nearest neighbors. We deal with the sliding window model, where outlier queries are performed in order to detect anomalies in the current window. The update of insertion or deletion only needs one scan of the current window, which improves efficiency. The capability of queries at arbitrary time on the whole current window is achieved by Query Manager procedure, which can capture the phenomenon of concept drift of data stream in time. Results of experiments conducted on both synthetic and real data sets show that SODRNN algorithm is both effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Moving Target Detection Based on Reconfigurable Video Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Moving target detection algorithm is PC-based software programming method to implement. At present, with slow processing speed and small scope of application problems, this paper takes System Generator for the development tool, which is a system-level modeling tool developed by Xilinx Inc, and built a reconfigurable video detection algorithm of moving target in MATLAB/Simulink environment, which is available for the FPGA platform, to achieve the detection of interest moving targets in the video scene. The experiment has testified that this method has many advantages, such as simple operation, flexible design, and high efficiency and so on.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Evaluation Method Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Assessment and Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper proposes we can integrated application with Fuzzy comprehensive Assessment and Markov Chain, based on introduction both of them, so that to improve the results of the evaluation of teachers more accuracy and scientific. At the end of paper, based on experiment results we focus on analyzing and Comparison between integrated application with the two methods and Single Fuzzy comprehensive Assessment.

articleTitle: A Competence Based Evaluation and Selection Problem by Fuzzy Linguistic Computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: For purposes of matching human resources to tasks, a manager might be interested, at first, in evaluating the different candidates according to the specific required criteria of the tasks. Those evaluations are considered as a good a priori definition of a selection problem variables. In the framework of the paper, we intend to provide a decision making tool to the manager for solving the multi-criteria selection problem that can accommodate the qualitative details in relations with the task requirements and candidates' competences. We outline the different steps of the proposed approach based on the combination of the linguistic competence evaluation processing based on the 2-tuple linguistic representation model and the multi-criteria decision making method, TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution). A didactic example is developed to illustrate each step of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Tangible Light: Back to Metaphor-Based Interaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In this paper we present Tangible light, a simple tangible interface that use behavioral and emotional metaphor to convey meaning in its interaction design. Our purpose is to take advantage of natural physical metaphor to achieve a heightened legibility and seamlessness of interaction between people and information. At the same time we attempts to make control system invisible with embedded sensors. Advances in sensor technology have provided novel approach for user to interact with daily used technical device. Rather than issuing commands to a object via multi-purpose and abstract buttons the way is designed for more nuanced and application-specific approaches. So here we explore the coupling of emotion and action in an interface designed for metaphor and simplicity while manipulate lights as an instance.

articleTitle: Disassembly Sequence Decision Making for Products Recycling and Remanufacturing Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The disassembly sequence decision making for used products is extremely important for recycling and reuse of components. In order to calculate the analysis difficulty of disassembly path in deciding on disassembly sequence of products, a decision-making model of product disassembly sequence with Fuzzy Reasoning Petri Nets (FRPN) is proposed. And then, combined fuzzy reasoning Petri nets with matrix operation, a reasoning algorithm of formalized is adopted to discuss the model of decision-making. Finally, an example is used to illustrate the applications of the proposed methodology. The result shows that the model of decision-making has strong parallel operation ability in the disassembly process sequence. The model can make intelligent decisions based on the product information from each disassembly step. It can also realize the automatic clustering identification and decrease the complexity of product disassembly.

articleTitle: Application of Adaptive Type-2 Fuzzy CMAC to Automatic Landing System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Computational intelligence that utilizes adaptive fuzzy cerebellar model articulation controller (FCMAC) to aircraft automatic landing system is proposed in this paper. The proposed intelligent scheme uses CMAC and type-2 fuzzy system. Current flight control law is adopted in the controller design. Lyapunov stability theory is applied to obtain adaptive learning rule and to guarantee stability of the automatic landing system. Performance on tracking desired landing path and environment adaptive capability are demonstrated through software simulations. The proposed intelligent system can guide the aircraft to a safe landing in severe turbulence condition and act as an experienced pilot.

articleTitle: Hybrid Simulated Annealing Algorithm Based on the Parallel Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The traditional serial simulated annealing algorithm has low efficiency, and is high depending on the setup parameters. The author presents a new hybrid parallel simulated annealing algorithm based on multi-thread parallel computing. Algorithm generates a set of random initial points, and then calculates a number of Markov chains in parallel. Each Markov chain has its own setup parameter. At every parallel point, the groups of parallel Markov chains' solutions are used to set the current global optimization strategies which will overcome premature convergence and improve the ability of searching global optima. A local search algorithms-Powell algorithm is used when the parallel annealing algorithm is finished at the approximate optimal point to improve the algorithm accuracy, and get the improved global optimal solution. The results show that the hybrid parallel simulated annealing algorithm can deal with multimodal function more effectively.

articleTitle: The Design and Realization of Acquisition Equipment in Remote Reading System Base on Low Voltage Power Line Carrier
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The acquisition equipment is the most important part in remote reading system base on low voltage power line carrier, it decides the data exactness and stabilization of the whole system. First to introduce the hardware design of an acquisition equipment; second to give an especial method to design the acquisition equipment software, this especial method is based on a storage strategy named token-ring, using this method, we not only can make sure the exactness, the safety of the data in memory and transmission about the acquiring data, but also can modify the inaccurate data via using the accurate data, this method boosts up the acquisition equipment. The acquisition equipment has been used in some city in Henan province, from the practically using, it approves that this storage strategy is useful.

articleTitle: Real-Time Emotion Assessment Method Based on Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: A real-time emotion assessment method based on physiological signals was proposed. Firstly, electrocardiography, skin temperature and galvanic skin response were selected as physiological signals. Physiological indicators were considered model inputs, to guarantee the method real-time assessment, simplified support vector machines (SVM) was used to infer affective states. The experimental results show that proposed method was useful. A number of following studies and usage in applications will show to which extent this new approach can serve the variety of requirements of emotion-related activities.

articleTitle: The Application of Data Mining in FFE of the Fashion Product Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Aiming at providing support for fashion product development, the research analysed the Fuzzy Front End in fashion design and the processes of the pre-development in the industry. The functions of data mining and its applications in fashion product development were discussed. A case study was conducted based on the data mining of the 3-D body scan measurements. Principal component analysis, correlation analysis, and the optimal bandwidth selection in kernel density estimation were employed to establish the specification of pants for target consumers. It is concluded that the data mining is an important tool to transform the data into information helpful in making development decision and solving technology problems.

articleTitle: Research on Product Image Form Design Based on ANFIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Product image form design, which focuses on customers' psychological demands, is arousing attention increasingly. This paper presents a novel approach of customer-oriented design for translating customers' kansei image into product design elements. The most influential form elements are identified through rough set theory. Based on this, the relationship between the key form elements and customers' kansei is constructed by adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) using MATLAB. To validate the prediction performance of ANFIS, fuzzy logic and back propagation neural network models are utilized. An experimental study of glasses design is conducted based on the proposed method, and the results suggest that ANFIS has a good prediction performance.

articleTitle: A Classifier Research Based on RS Reducts and SVM Ensemble
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In order to construct a high-performance ensemble classifier, it needs that the basic classifiers, which contained by the ensemble one, have higher classification precision and their classification error is independent from each other. In fact, it is too difficult to choose these basic classifiers satisfying the two conditions above. Rough reduction is the core in the fields of Rough Set theory. Each reduct not only contains lesser attributes, but also is independent from each other in classification error. SVM is a promising method of machine learning based on the structural risk minimization principle, which has high classification precision. In the paper, an ensemble classifier algorithm based on RS reducts and SVM is provided in order to construct a high-performance classifier. Experiment shows that our proposed algorithm is efficient and has better classification accuracy and better performance.

articleTitle: Research on TinyOS Scheduling Strategy Based on SJP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Aiming at the status that the TinyOS job scheduling uses the non-privative first-come-first-served policy, the system emergency jobs can't get quick response, and its node throughput decreases, this paper proposes a new preempting algorithm, Short Job Priority (SJP): through executing hard real-time job within absolute time deadline to meet the requirements of the system response to the real-time job, and improve the processor's response speed; By means of executing soft real-time job based on short job priority strategy, the system throughput is increased. The TinyOS test results indicated that without affecting the original performance of TinyOS, the SJP strategy greatly improved the running effect of the sensor when it undertakes net real-time jobs.

articleTitle: Feature Selection for Online Writeprint Identification Using Hybrid Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: One major task of online writeprint identification is to select the key features for representing the writeprint and facilitating the classifier built by using only the selected feature subset. In this study, we develop a hybrid genetic algorithm: RelieF Fed Genetic Algorithm (RFGA) which incorporates feature weight information produced by using RelieF as the heuristic to identity the key features and improve the identification performance. Experiments are conducted on a test bed encompassing hundreds of reviews posted by 20 Amazon customers to examine the method. The experimental results using RFGA show the proposed approach is effective, obtaining a significant improvement in performance, with satisfactory classification accuracy of 96.67%, and having a heavy reduction in feature dimensionality that is only 3% of the no feature selection baseline.

articleTitle: The Improvement of Current Feed-Forward Control Strategy on Voltage Source PWM Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Based on power conservation, this paper improves the current feed-forward control strategy on voltage source PWM rectifier, in order to remove the current sensor in dc side, and reduce hardware cost. The results of simulation with MATLAB/SIMULINK demonstrate the feasibility of the method proposed in this paper. Document is a “live” template. The various components of your paper.

articleTitle: Model Selection in Support Vector Machines Using Self-Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The support vector machine is a powerful supervised learning algorithm that has been successfully applied to a plenty of fields including text and image recognition, medical diagnosis and so on. The kernel and its parameters optimization, formally known as model selection, is a crucial factor which influences a good tradeoff between bias and variance. To automate model selection of support vector machine, this paper presents a strategy utilizing self-adaptive genetic algorithm and data distribution to determine the kernel function and all the free kernel parameters. The model selection criterion using a novel fitness function with hyperplane radius and a off-spring individual selection method during the process of constructing the model. The experiments on well known benchmark data sets are carried out to validate the effectiveness of proposed strategy. The experimental results show that using genetic algorithm to tune the model is a promising way to enhance the performance of support vector machine.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Industrial Product Innovative Design Base on Scenario-FBS Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Three types of behavior scenario: aesthetic, strategic and semantic have been proposed based on the research on the logic and sequential cognitive process of design. According to the research on the feature elements of scenario and their interactive relationship, a scenario-FBS model of industrial design has been built. Based on the scenario-FBS model, a computer aided industrial design system of CNC machine tools has been developed to help the practical design. The good results have been achieved.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of GMDSS Equipment Operation Computer Assessment System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper probes the design of the computer intelligent evaluation system of GMDSS equipments operation in VC++ developing environment. Programming methods and implementation process of the computer assessment system is discussed in detail. This system can be used to assess the ability of examinee's equipment operation instead of assessors.

articleTitle: Research on Product Design Driven by Reach Area
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In traditional design, ergonomic design is often used to examine in product design. If the ergonomic examination has serious problem, it needs to modify the size of the product structure that extend the design cycle. Using the computer-aided ergonomics technology, product design driven by human body posture system framework has been constructed in this paper. This article analyzes the operating posture and has constructed the human body operating space through reach area. The shape and size of the working area obtained is used to restrain the product idea mold size. Namely, the ergonomic factor is considered in the initial period of product design, reduced the design cost and increased the design efficiency and the security.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation of Transmission Line Based on GATS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In power system, remote measurement data are sent to control center to estimate system state. These data can also be used to estimate parameters of transmission line when errors occur to them. In the case that the measurements contain noises, the estimated parameters may deviate the true value seriously. This paper proposes a hybrid method to estimate the parameters of transmission line. The method consists of Genetic Algorithm and Tabu Search, and integrates the advantages both of them. A correction term, based on design parameters, is brought into the objective function to improve the estimating capability. This method has strong search ability and independence on the initial value, and suits for parallel computing. The simulation results of IEEE 14 bus system illustrate this method effective.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Quantum-Behaved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Aiming at the drawback of being easily trapped into the local optima and premature convergence in quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization algorithm, fuzzy quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization algorithm was proposed. In fuzzy quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization algorithm, the center of potential of particle was influenced by more than two particles in the neighborhood and the influence was defined as fuzzy variable that is computed by Gaussian distribution. The simulation results of testing four standard benchmark functions demonstrate that fuzzy quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization algorithm has best optimization performance and robustness, the validity and feasibility of the method are verified.

articleTitle: Application of the Election Campaign Optimization Algorithm to Engineering Optimum Design Problems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper investigates the application of Election Campaign Algorithm (ECA) in the optimum design of engineering problems. With ECA'S characteristic of running side by side, the overall optimization and feasible operation, the optimum matching of the design variables is obtained based on the optimum design model of engineering problems. Simulation results based on well-known constrained engineering design problems demonstrate the reliability and feasibility of ECA's application. ECA is suitable for solving engineering optimization design problems.

articleTitle: Method of Watershed with Threshold Decision for Multiscale Traffic Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The main problem that watershed image segmentation facing is over segmentation. The paper that combines adaptive threshold decision and watersheds improves the traditional image segmentation technology. Firstly, applying the wavelet transform to get the detail and approximation information. Based on the gradient magnitudes of the approximation image at the coarsest resolution, an adaptive threshold is used to remove minor gradient value. Finally, the watershed transform is applied. The result of experiments indicates the method produces a good segmentation and efficiently reduces over segmentation.

articleTitle: Application of Cloud Computing in the Network Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Nowadays, the cloud computing exists on the Internet. And Google already allows people port some of their personal data to the Internet and use its Web-based software. If there is no cloud computing, which is impossible, in this paper, author will introduce Google sites, it is a case that the Cloud computing applied in the network learning environment. Google sites offer a free (and ad-free) Set of customizable tools that enable faculty, staff and students to work together and learn more effectively.

articleTitle: Application of BP Neural Networks on Prediction of Operating Condition of Loom
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In order to forecast quickly the operating condition of the loom, optimize the parameters of loom production, so that the production efficiency of loom will be improved. This paper studies the prediction of the operating condition of the loom based on the neural networks. The neural networks technology is applied to forecast the operating condition of the loom production, establishes corresponding prediction model of loom production. With the help of neural networks samples are trained and checked, then are applied to forecast the operating condition of the loom production, the results are compared with the Bayesian theorem. The study indicates that network model based on the neural networks has reliability and high accuracy.

articleTitle: The Application of Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model in the Performance Assessment of State-Owned Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: On the basis of the rationality of indicators and availability of data, we design a performance evaluating indicator system of state-owned enterprises. Under the guideline of fuzzy mathematics, we use Delphi method and entropy weight method to determine the weights of the indicators and establish a fuzzy comprehensive evaluating model for the performance assessment of state-owned enterprises. To illustrate the model, we evaluate the performance of four enterprises in the area of real estate and project management of Luhua Energy Group. The result of the study is to provide an idea for operators and managers to acquire and improve the situation of the enterprises.

articleTitle: Cast Batch Planning for Steelmaking and Continuous Casting Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: A multi-objective 0-1 integer programming model is established in order to solve the complex problem of cast batch planning for steelmaking and continuous casting which is considered as vehicle routing problem. To solve the complex multi-constrained, multi-objective cast batch planning model for steelmaking and continuous casting, a method is proposed which combines rules with ant colony algorithm. The algorithm is tested by online data. Results show that the proposed algorithm can quickly workout the optimal cast batch planning for steelmaking and continuous casting, and can lay the firm groundwork for application to production process in the future.

articleTitle: A High Accuracy Compact Difference on Non-uniform Grid for 2D Convection Diffusion Reaction Equation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: By use of the method of dimension reduction, the two-dimensional convection diffusion reaction equation is firstly divided into the sum of two one-dimensional convection diffusion reaction equations. Based on the Taylor progression on non-uniform grid, a high accuracy compact difference for one-dimensional convection diffusion reaction equation is proposed. Finally, we combine the two compact differences for one-dimensional convection diffusion reaction equation to get the high accuracy compact difference for two-dimensional convection diffusion reaction equation. The numerical experiment shows that the present scheme are much more accuracy than that in uniform grid with the same number of grid points.

articleTitle: Research on a Method of Projectile's Induced Signals Acquisition and Muzzle Velocity Measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The muzzle velocity is an important evaluation standard of weapons system performance. The measurement of muzzle velocity is great significance on the trajectory research. This paper presents a method of using photoelectric target detection, using the CPLD programmable logic devices and microprocessor CY7C68013 integrating USB2.0 interface technology to achieve muzzle velocity measurement. In the hardware, speed measurement circuit is embedded CPLD chip in the form of hardware description language. In this way, the system's design flexibility and operational stability could be improved. Applying USB2.0 interface technology for data communication between the host PC and the client PC ensures high speed data transmission. In the software, the firmware program of CY7C68013 chip and the host PC application software are developed and the program running meets measurement accuracy and real time. Experimental results show that the system could capture the projectile's induced signals and measure muzzle velocity accurately. The system has a high application value.

articleTitle: Data Modeling for Searching Abnormal Noise in Stock Market Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper attempts to illustrate the negative impact on Rat Trading in stock market, one of the noise trading forms. In addition, this paper also presents the preliminary design searching the Rat Trading monitoring system including its framework, a genetic algorithm mathematical model, based on genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on the Comparison of Several Denoising Theories and Effects about Vibration Signal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In order to obtain random vibration signals of structure accurately, it is necessary to the collected vibration signals which are processed to remove the interference factors and noise components. In this paper, three methods to noise reduction are introduced, which are the wavelet method, IIR numeric filter, and singular entropy technique separately. Construct analog signal with varying degrees of noise, and the noise is reduced based on the above methods, and also the SNR index is calculated separately after noise reduction. Study shows that method of singular entropy technique can determine the proper order of singular spectrum of the random vibration signal, and ensure the integrity of information contained in the signal after noise reduction and the maximum SNR improvement to a large extent.

articleTitle: Research on the Identification Method of Lithology Drilling with PDC Bit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: While drilling with PDC Bit, Some problems are come out when using the methods of traditional recorder well because Lithology is hard to identify. The data collected by mud-logging equipment, for examples, ROP, WOB, torque et al., reflects the different properties of rock in the formation of subsurface. The relation among them is complex and BP neural network is adopted in three layers. The depth section between 2,500m and 2,700m of Well Zhang2104 is used to train predictive model in Zhangdian oil field. In order to test the precision of the model, the depth section (2,000m~2,200m) of Well Zhang2104 and Well Zhang2201 (2,600m~2,800m) are predicted. The precision predicted to Zhang2104 is 93.6% and Well Zhang2201 is 89.2%, but it is almost 100% in the pure rocks. The identification errors center on the rock filled with about 50% clay. The result proves that this method is practical.

articleTitle: A New K-Neighbor Search Algorithm Based on Variable Incremental Dynamic Grid Division
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: K-neighbor search algorithm is an important class of query type in the spatial database, a new K-neighbor search algorithm based on variable incremental dynamic grid division is proposed in this paper, which is under the analysis of the traditional K-neighbor search algorithm based on dynamic grid division, this algorithm will carry on clustering to the data objects around the queried data object, use the side length of the smallest bounding rectangle which is formed due to the cluster to carry on incremental expansion and form the dynamic grid, the grid achieved can reasonably divide the data objects, make full use of the storage space and reflect the position relationship between the data objects, so it can avoid a waste of storage space because of equidistant division in the opposite direction of each dimension in the past and overcome the shortcoming of not effectively searching because it can not divide the adjacent data objects together, it can achieve the fast K-neighbor queries, the experiments show that this search algorithm can reduce the node access times and the CPU running time, so it has an excellent performance.

articleTitle: Research on SOA and Component Oriented Technology in Development of Large System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: SOA is a new methodology to be used in the software development in recently. But the interrelated standards and specifications about SOA are very complicated and confused for most users. After analyzing the misapprehending on the application of SOA, it gives some reasoning and suggestion for the uses of SOA, and shows a sample about the light-weight SOA product model. A new approach based on SOA and Web service component oriented technologies has been proposed and applied in the refinery enterprise. The relevant technologies about SOA and Web service to realize ERP and other large systems have been researched in detail.

articleTitle: A Study on the Method of Mobile Content Recommendation Based on Situations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In existing mobile content service systems, the study is quite rare on automatic situation-service rule construction. Hence, a method is proposed that the semantic association rules between situations and preferences are built by quantitative frequent marked lattice. Different recommendation rules can be extracted along multi-dimensional context routes from this lattice structure. It is propitious to solve the problems of rule collisions and availability of context data. The algorithm is studied for frequent marked lattice construction and the priority is designed for rule extraction. Finally, the advantage and feasibility of the proposed method is demonstrated by a calculating instance.

articleTitle: Coupled-Field Analysis of FRP Pipe under Thermal and Internal Pressure Loads
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Due to the high corrosion, high strength-to-weigh ratio and low thermal conductivity, the fiber reinforced polymer(FRP) materials are increasingly being used for the large diameter pipe, which is used to transport hot water. The temperature of the hot water is 45°C, and the ambient air temperature is 3°C in the extreme working conditions. So the strength analysis is necessary under thermal and internal pressure loads. The study is conducted numerically using thermal-structural couple element type. The results demonstrate that the strength and stiffness of the FRP pipe meet the requirements of the ASME code.

articleTitle: Improving the Fault-Tolerant Scheme Based on the RSA System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Fault tolerance and encryption are two key themes in modern communication systems. The author proposes an improved approach to integrate fault tolerance, encryption and digital signature. A pseudorandom permutation matrix is adopted to randomize the cipher matrix, forcing attackers to solve the homogeneous problem. The novel scheme is more secure against adaptive chosen ciphertext attacks than those available.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Adaptive Control of Free-Floating Space Robot Based on Dead-Zone Compensator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper proposes a fuzzy adaptive controller based on dead-zone compensator for a free-floating space robot (FFSR) in the presence of the unmodeled nonlinear dynamics and additional disturbances. In the micro-gravity space environment, the FFSR lacks a fixed base. As a result, there is high dynamic coupling between the manipulators and the free-floating base, which leads to two inherent difficulties, which are non-linear parameterization of the dynamic equation and both kinematic and dynamic parameter uncertainties. These uncertainties make the dynamic equation of FFSR more complicated than that of the fix-based comparisons. And the control method for fixbased robot can not be applied directly for the FFSR system. In order to overcome these obstacles, we use the dead-zone compensator including a fuzzy control system to approximate the nonlinear dynamic function. The proposed controller could not only overcome the uncertainty but also efficiently track the desired trajectory of the manipulator joints in a finite time. The stability of the whole system is analyzed and then the structure of the controller is given. Through numerical simulations, the validity of the proposed scheme is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Method to Improve the Retinex Image Enhancement Algorithm Based on Wavelet Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Images are low definition captured from the camera under the condition of insufficient light, and it is difficult to identify or distinguish the content of the images. Based on Retinex theory, applying the enhance operations for these images can reduce the low definition effect caused by weak and dark sunlight. But it should be noted that Retinex method for these images would cause strong saturation that do not fit for human vision. In order to reduce strong saturation, wavelet theory was used to improve Retinex algorithm. The results of the simulation show that the improvement can achieve more effective integration from the theory and human vision. It is superior to the traditional SSR method.

articleTitle: Real-Time 3DUI Research Based on Virtools
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The progress of virtual reality technology demands more about the real-time and naturalness of the interface. Based on the classification research on human-computer interfaces in 3D scene, this paper explored the real-time 3Dimensional User Interface (3DUI) in virtual reality interaction, and through practices on the 3DVIA Virtools platforms, presented the implementation principle and some specific operations of the interface.

articleTitle: The Research for Experiment and Elman Neural Network Model of High Manganese Steel Drilling Power
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: As a difficult processing material, the drilling of the high manganese steel has been a difficulty among the mechanical processing industry, because its plastic deformation is great and produces the serious hardening phenomenon in the course of processing. During the process of drilling the high manganese steel, great cutting force will be produced, so the great power of the lathe can be consumed. This paper, through improving with the geometric parameter of the cemented carbide bit, the goal of improving the drilling power has been achieved. The improvement has been done on the rake angle of main cutting edge, outer fringe cusp and chisel edge. Meanwhile, Elman neural network model of drilling power based on experimental data is obtained. Effective prediction and simulation has been achieved on the power of the high manganese steel drilling.

articleTitle: Research of Granularity Pair and Dynamic Hierarchical Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The uncertainty of the border leads to the dynamics of granularity pair. In order to characterize the dynamic trend that the difference degree is close to the identity degree, the confidence threshold is introduced. Based on the positive correlation between the confidence threshold and the border of granularity pair, this paper proposes a new algorithm for dynamic hierarchy. The example shows that the algorithm is feasible.

articleTitle: Synchronous Communication Research and Implementation of Evolutionary Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: It has been almost ten years since Evolutionary Cryptography is brought forward. It has yielded substantial results in cryptographic components and function design. However, Evolutionary cryptography still has many problems unsolved in the process of going to practical applications. This paper researches in detail, concludes the generalized model of evolutionary cryptography and analyzes the influence of every component in the model to synchronous communication. We design the model of synchronous communication of evolutionary cryptography. Experimental results indicate that this model can guarantee the correctness of evolutionary cryptography design, and at the same time the model can also reduce the burden of practical applications and fit the bill of security communication.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Research on Decision Model Based on Bayesian Techniques for an NPC in Computer Games
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In modern computer games, a NPC (non-player character) can make choices. In the previous researches, a NPC can have the certain knowledge in a game world; this will reduce the believability of perception for a NPC. A decision model based on Bayesian network and fuzzy logic for a NPC is set up in this paper; a NPC can partially know domain knowledge. A behavior animation of a virtual dog by the model is realized on PC, the results show that the virtual dog can behave believable in watching a house.

articleTitle: The Research of Software Automation on Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The technology of software automatic generation in the field of monitoring system has been studied. A set of technologies and methods of software automatic generation for a specific field has been proposed. It can be realized by two steps: the inductive procedure from specific to general one and the deductive procedure from general to specific one. According to inducing and abstracting from many application systems, the system model has been built. Then, by application description, configuring parameters and compiler, the function modules, which the system is needed, can be realized. By the parameters which users' inputting, system module generates system strategies and configuration files. Under the control of system strategies, it combines modules and their configuration files accordingly, and then generates the whole application system.

articleTitle: The Research on Benefit Coordination Mechanism of Project Stakeholders
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: With the increasing complexity of the project, how to coordinate the interests of project stakeholders has become a practical problem urgent to be solved, fair and reasonable interests coordination mechanism plays an important role for the success of the project. Therefore, the project's risk-sharing and benefit distribution among stakeholders is studied in this article, and we hope it could provide some practical reference for project management.

articleTitle: Eyes Detection Based on One-Dimensional Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm for eyes detection based on one-dimensional wavelet transform and gray-level integration projection. First, nonlinear color transformation is used to detect skin color region, which can be used to acquired possible skin areas. According to the geometric characteristics of eyes, horizontal integral projection is used to upper face, then using wavelet transform for projecting curve in order to exclude interference, and eyes approximate area can be extracted. Finally, vertical integral projection is used to eyes approximate position and wavelet transform is used for projection curve, thus exact positions of eyes can be located. This paper uses the camera to capture the face image, and the algorithm has advantages of low computation complexity, high speed and better detection effect.

articleTitle: Emergency Evacuation Model Based on Multi-agent System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: By analyzing the evacuee's characters of psychology, physical and behavior, a common Agent model is build up, and this model is the basis of evacuation model. The interaction between evacuees is also discussed. On this basis, a simple example based on multi-Agent theory is described.

articleTitle: The Research on System Construction and Design Communication of Virtual Pavilion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This thesis indicates the significance and feasibility of virtual pavilion in today's development of exhibition industry, and analyze the necessity and urgency of establishing and improving virtual pavilion as Internet technological advances rapidly in China and exhibition industry has taken on a tendency of internationalization. Besides, it reveals the elements and design principles of system construction and design communication of virtual pavilion in China's exhibition industry, which mainly contains eight sections: introduction of organizers, information about attendance and visit, news of exhibition, cooperation units' presentation, introduction to virtual pavilion, e-commerce platform, business information and forum communication. In addition, this thesis points out the design philosophy of content planning and coordinating interaction design.

articleTitle: Advanced a New Vector Data Query Optimization Method Based on Cost Function
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: With the development of information technology, the bandwidth network resources begin not only more and more poor, but also restrict the vector data query speed. In order to improve the query speed, this paper proposed a novel vector data inquiry method which is optimized and can transplant to the client based on analyzing the method of massive data inquiry, combing with the query optimized method based on the cost function. At last, we apply this theory in cable monitoring system in Beijing of Grid State; it proved that this method is effective on improving the inquiry speed and maintaining a good network-load performance.

articleTitle: Applications of Fuzzy Comprehensive Assessment and Analytic Hierarchy Process Model in the Comprehensive Profit Assessment of Ecological Water Compensation in Heihe River
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This article established the assessment model of Fuzzy Comprehensive Assessment (FCA) and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), based on the methods of AHP and FCA, and applied this model in the comprehensive profit assessment (CPA) of ecological water compensation in Heihe River basin. The result of this research is realistic and able to be popularized.

articleTitle: Research of Heterogeneous Authentication Information Synchronization Based on LDAP and Web Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Nowadays LDAP is more and more widely applied to uniform identity authentication system because of its cross-platform characteristic and high availability. However, identity authentication information usually comes from specific application systems and is maintained by these application systems. What's more, databases of these application systems are heterogeneous with LDAP. In order to solve the problem that heterogeneous data repositories can not share their information, this paper introduces LDAP and web service in detail and employs web service to synchronize identity authentication information from databases to LDAP, which can make identity authentication information effective and consistent.

articleTitle: A Sense of Reality Human Face Modeling Research Based on Multi-angle Photograph
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The sense of reality human face modeling technology is a very important research in the computer graphic area. This paper propose a specific modeling technology from a general human face modeling. We can capture the multi-angle photograph of human face by digital camera, pre-process these pictures, add characteristic points to the human face picture, project the degree of general human face grid model to these pictures. Then we need to adjust the location of characteristic points in the general human face until they are the same as the points in the pictures and adjust the location of non-characteristic points by RBF(Radial Basis Functions) interpolation. At last, we can have the specific human face model by texture mapping and the experiment has proved the this technology is able to achieve the sense of reality human face modeling effectively.

articleTitle: Decision of Optimum Open-Pit Slope Angle Based on Artifical Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: A BP artificial neural network model was established to optimize the final slope angle of open-pit mine, which was based on its powerful self-learning, nonlinear processing capabilities and advantages of simulation for the slope stability with nonlinear relationship among the parameters. The consideration of effect on the stability of the slope includes Protodrakonov scale of hardness, dip angle of rock stratum, development degree of joint crevice, average annual rainfall, mining depth and final slope angle. The network topology structure of 5-11-1 was built, and the accuracy of the simulation result is above 92 percent. The results show that the specific structure of BP networks can better optimize the final pit slope angle and meet the precision requirement of mining project, which provides a unique advantage of systems analysis in the field of geotechnical engineering application.

articleTitle: Analysis and Improvement of Virtual Work Criteria for Structure Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: An improvement of virtual work criteria for structure optimization is presented to overcome the shortcomings caused by the neglect of dead weight and inertial load of structure in solution of criteria equations. Deduction of criteria equations is analyzed to prove that the shortcomings lead to the error of structure optimization. Therefore, new criteria equations are formulated using the displacement representation of algebraic sum and matrices. According to the characteristics of the improved criteria equations, an improved Aitken algorithm is applied to solve the equations in order to implement the complete automatization of iterative solution for structure optimization. The algorithm is proved to be an accelerated iterative method, and its convergence order is estimated. The feasibility of improved criteria equations and the merits of improved Aitken algorithm are demonstrated by an illustrative example showing five-bar truss. The results show that the improvement of virtual work criteria provides a structure optimization method for precision machine.

articleTitle: Application and the Conditional Granularity Entropy Operator in the Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In order to solve the problem which the heredity genes of the chromosomes are relatively more in the classical genetic algorithms, a new operator is put forward in this paper. The algorithm turns the group's character information into the information system which is used in the granular computing, and makes use of the conditional granularity entropy to reduce the genes when the value is larger relatively, so that it can reduce the computational complexity. The experiment shows the algorithm rationality when the problems are analyzed.

articleTitle: Nonlinear System Control Using a Recurrent Neural Fuzzy Network Based on Reinforcement Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper proposes a recurrent neural fuzzy network with the reinforcement improved particle swarm optimization (R-IPSO) for solving various control problems. The R-IPSO, which consists of structure learning and parameter learning, is also proposed. The structure learning is adopts several sub-swarms to constitute variable fuzzy systems and uses an elite-based structure strategy (ESS) to find suitable the number of fuzzy rules for solving a problem. The parameter learning is adopts an improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO). The examples have been given to illustrate the performance and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Structural Feature Extraction from Regular-Shaped Rigid Objects(2) - Enhanced by Prior Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The structural feature extraction from regular-shaped rigid objects is continuously studied. Some rules based on prior knowledge are proposed to improve the effects of the same subject(1). First, some rules are introduced for recovery of the missing true features. Then, some rules for distinguishment between true features and pseudo features are proposed, which is suggested be executed in a recursive way. Last, a graph structure that represents the connection of the corners is established, which group the corner features according to connectivity components. Experiments validate that the proposed approaches have higher detection rate and much lower error rate than the approach in the same subject(1). The proposed approaches make complete the true features on the silhouette of the objects and remove many pseudo features. All these pave the way for future structural recognition.

articleTitle: Study of Business Acquaintances Recommendation Approach Based on Workflow Log
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In the migrating workflow system based on the mobile computing paradigm, the key problem of migrating workflow is how to select an appropriate workplace for migrating instance. In this paper, we propose a business acquaintances recommendation approach based on workflow log. In this approach, there is not a complete business process definition in workplace. However, according to the workflow log and the knowledge of the acquaintances, it can recommend the next workplace for migrating instance through the analysis of migrating instance paths till the completion of the task.

articleTitle: Laser Antimissile System Strategy Optimization Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The attacking sequence optimization of laser antimissile system plays an important role in the real-time application. When faced with multiple attacking targets, it is clearly important for the laser antimissile system to determine the sequence of the attacking targets to be intercepted so that the maximum attacking targets are destroyed. Conceptually, this laser antimissile problem can be seen as a dynamical traveling salesman problem, which is much harder than a pure traveling salesman problem. In fact, it is a dynamical shortest path problem. But there are many barriers for finding the global optimal solution, especially when the number of the targets is greater than six. The dynamical inversion algorithm includes the inner flip and the outer flip; it partially solves the premature convergence problem. Finally, taking eight targets as an example, the simulation results show that the convergence of the algorithm is very fast and this achievement can be used in the real application.

articleTitle: Study on Distribution Model of Positioning Unit in Pervasive Computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In the three-dimensional positioning process, pervasive computing requires higher positioning accuracy and fast response to the location information. Based on the analysis of the traditional location algorithm, the study on regional errors found that four positioning reference nodes in the space could improve the positioning accuracy according to a certain distribution model, showing better provision of location services. Thus, the distribution model theorem on space positioning unit was proposed. Based on this, improvement was made on the traditional polygon location algorithm, with the positioning unit selection algorithm proposed accordingly. Simulation results presented that in this paper, the positioning unit distribution model theorem and the positioning unit selection algorithm were able to better meet the needs for real-time positioning of the pervasive terminals, with higher positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: A Study of Distributed Remote Sensing Data Sharing Platforms Based on Web Services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Web services are a service-oriented architecture that has gradually advanced in recent years. Offering such benefits as protocol interoperability, complete independence from platforms and languages, and high degree of loose coupling, they have become an increasingly important way for seamless application integration. Coupling the characteristics of remote sensing data and genera l principles for designing sharing systems, the authors of this paper will advance an open data storage integration model and service model based on open specifications and protocols, put forward the design for a sharing platform and data notes based on web services in a distributed environment and illustrate key technologies and innovative features for this platform.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Analysis of MSMA Actuator Based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The magnetically controlled Shape Memory alloy (MSMA) is a new type of intelligent materials, which has large strain and high efficiency of electromechanical energy conversion, but at this time it is not actually used as actuators. So in this paper we mainly expounded the working principle of MSMA actuator and completed magnetic field analysis of it based on ANSYS. The paper provides reference for the structure design and material selection for MSMA actuator; meanwhile, it accelerates the MSMA actuator design process.

articleTitle: Hybrid Active Power Filter DC Bus Control Based on Fuzzy PID Control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: With the existing problem of the static error and the overshoot of DC bus voltage control methods, a hybrid active power filter control system was designed. Considering special characteristics of the DC bus voltage control, the parameter self-tuning fuzzy PID control method combine the fuzzy control with PID control is proposed. Compared with traditional PID control method, this control method has the feature of robust, the small overshoot and the steady-state error. Simulation results prove that the control system possesses the excellent Correctness and Feasibility.

articleTitle: Extended Evaluation for Quality of Service in the Community of Web Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: When Web service evaluation attributes involve beyond service domain, they aren't credible or unable to get, if they only come from service domain. In this article, extended evaluation model for quality of service in the community of Web service is presented. In the model, Web service community is set up, and main service in the community can associate this domain with other domain. Evaluation tree and evaluation forest are defined, which makes it possible to correctly evaluate service in different domain. A new TFAHP which has fuzzy evaluation adjustment attribute is proposed, and approach of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is improved. At the same time based on combination of them, a new evaluation algorithm to the model is created. The model improves reliability of the evaluation.

Author Keywords: new triangular fuzzy analytic hierarchy process

articleTitle: Speed Identification of Asynchronous Motor Based on Adaptive Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Sensorless vector control has been studied broadly, and motor speed identification is exactly very important. According to the fundamental equations of asynchronous motor for vector control, a MRAS speed identification algorithm is obtained by measured motor stator voltage and currents. The simulation result shows that this MRAS speed identification model meets the needs of dynamic characteristic and identification precision.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Robust Optimal Design Based on Fuzzy Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In robust optimal design, the design objective often involves multiple aspects such as “bringing the mean of performance on target” and “minimizing the variations”. Current ways of handling multiple aspects using either the Taguchi’s signal-to-noise ratio or the weighted-sum method are not adequate. And in process and production design, there are a lot of fuzzy factors and random factors. In this paper, we solve multi-objective robust optimal design problems from a practical perspective by fuzzy mathematics. Firstly, we review the discrete tolerance design model which is often used in computer aided tolerance design. Secondly we gain the satisfactorily global optimal solution of the multi-objective problem by use of principle of fuzzy closeness optimization. At last results from applying the above techniques to an optimal example show that the proposed approach is effective.

articleTitle: Research and Application of PSO-BP Neural Networks in Credit Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: According to the complexity of financial system, the model of credit risk assessment based on PSO algorithm and BP neural network integrated is proposed, which in order to improve the accuracy and reliability of risk assessment. First the neural network model of a credit risk evaluation is created, and then PSO algorithm is introduced to optimize the weight and threshold of the neural network, at last, using the indexes and regarding relevant data of 250 enterprises as sample, the BP neural network is trained and tested. Compared with the traditional calculation methods, experimental results show that the method is a feasible and effective assessment method with fast convergence and high precision prediction.

articleTitle: Researching Three-Dimensional Modeling of Surface that Based on .NET Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The paper showed three-dimensional surface modeling software with independent intellectual property rights-GeoModeling. Developing this software based on Microsoft's. NET platform, used the C # language, and used sample framework process of the managed Direct3D. It can be applied for geological research and display of geological achievements.

articleTitle: On the Biomimetic Design of Low-Carbon Economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In this paper bionic design was described from the angle of low-carbon, the bionic methods to live in harmony with nature was improve and finally intergrowth with each other. Nature development is the origin of bionic design and function is the foundation of the design, so we shall start from this foundation to appreciate the world, and also be aware of the essence of nature, absorb the inspiration. We can find a kind of natural rational bionic through the re-creating process of stylist. This is the process of bionic designs in low carbon levels.

articleTitle: A New Method for Measuring Individual Importance in Social Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Nowadays, centrality computing is the most common measure for finding important actors in Social Network Analysis (SNA). In this paper, we proposed a new method SHITS applied to social networks to find relatively important actors. This new method assigns two attribute values to each actor, namely SAuthority and SHub, among which SAuthority denotes the value themselves and SHub evaluates the intermediary functions they have. It can discover more valuable and useful information than traditional ways. And we also use newsmth BBS as an example to specify SHITS. Finally the experiment results show the method can discover some hidden information which verified our algorithm is validated.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Rural Power Network Reform Project Based on Rough Set and Support Vector Machine in Inner Mongolia
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: In this paper, index system for project evaluation of rural power network reform was established, based on the status of rural power network reform in Inner Mongolia, and according to the characteristics of large number of indicators, evaluation model of rural power network reform was proposed based on rough sets and support vector machine. In the article, the empirical analysis are done on the evaluation data of rural power network reform in Inner Mongolia, and the reformed rural network brought remarkable benefit that prove the method has high classification accuracy, the results show that the model works well, and the method is practical and feasible.

articleTitle: The Commercial Banks Operational Risk Evaluation Based on EAHP and Gray Correlation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: How to manage operational risk effectively has become a crucial point in commercial bank risk management. Based on the operational risk definition and supervision requirements in Basel capital accord II, adopted expanded AHP, this paper has constructed an operational risk evaluation indicator system which covers the influential factors inside and outside of banks. The specific evaluation steps are illustrated in the gray correlation evaluation model.

articleTitle: Product Design for Low-Income Group Base on User-Centered Design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: There're plenty of people belong to Low-income group all over the world. But only a few of designers concern about their demand. This paper is aimed at using the method and idea of “user-centered design (UCD)” to study on low-income group. The key of UCD is design for users' demand and benefit, according to this, this paper analyzed 5 helpful design characteristics of target user. Based on the theory, a case was studied on diet solution system for “Ant Family”, low-income youth in major cities of China. On the basis of above study, this paper gives advice that it needs more designers to create for low-income group, and is worth to pay more attention for the potential value.

articleTitle: Incidence Rate of Hypertension Forecasting Based on Generalized Regression Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Objective To study the superiority and application prospect of generalized regression neural network (GRNN) which is used in forecasting the incidence rate of hypertension. Methods Use meteorological data, including average temperature, average pressure and relative humidity, and hypertension incidence rate from January 2003 to December 2008 as the input of neural network. Use the incidence rate of hypertension from February 2003 to December 2009 as the output of neural network. Construct the GRNN forecasting model and BP neural network forecasting model respectively with the neural network toolbox of matlab7.0. Fit and forecast the sample and compare the performance between the two different neural networks. Results The optimize smooth factor of GRNN is 0.24; The hidden layer of BP neural network is 3. From the forecasting effect, the MER between the two neural networks are 0.10% and 0.27% respectively. The MER of GRNN is less than the MER of BP neural network; their are 0.956 and 0.867. Conclusion GRNN is more superior in small sample forecasting than BP neural network, and the forecasting effect is better. GRNN has practical value in solving epidemic problem which has complicate influencing factor such as hypertension.

articleTitle: Comparative Research on the Remote Control Interface Cognition Oriented to Universal Design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: The universal design evaluation of projector remote control interface has important meaning to the businesses and users, which is a multi-user-oriented hand-held device. The article first discussed the concepts and principles of universal design, as well as the research methods of PPP, USS, etc. On this basis, it selected EPSON, SONY, and SANYO projector remote controls, successively had tests on the product used phases from unfamiliar to familiar through PPP methods, and then had comparative tests for 7 items and 23 categories including Comfort, Convenience and Clarity, Freedom, Accuracy, Consistency, Fault tolerance, etc. Finally, it put forward the improved suggestions on comprehension button interface, the number of the button and operating procedures etc.

articleTitle: State Description of Mine Construction Project Based on MES and S (I)
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: Mine construction process is complicated, accurate record of construction state is an important aspect of project management. Take MES concept into the description of Mine Construction Project State, the entire mining Construction Project are divided into several sub-projects, and each sub-project is divided into several processes, by recording the state of each process to describe the mining Construction state, provides new ideas and methods for coal mine construction project management.

articleTitle: Research on Diagnosis Process of Forest Pests and Diseases Based on Fuzzy Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design
abstract: This paper applies the fuzzy reasoning into the process of the forestry pests and diseases's diagnosis. Firstly, it introduces the fuzzy reasoning and the expert system, and then a new design method is proposed, which can carries on the objective quantitative analysis and effective processing to each kind of indefinite information. At last this method is taken into application and The practice indicates that it can enhances forestry pests and diseases expert system's reliability and the intelligence.
